eval: (() => { const g = game; window.__mem = () => { if (window.gc) window.gc(); const m = performance.memory; const r = g.engine.renderer.info.memory; return { heapMB: m ? +(m.usedJSHeapSize / 1048576).toFixed(1) : null, geometrias: r.geometries, texturas: r.textures, objetosNaCena: g.engine.scene.children.length, chunks: g.chunks.stats, passaros: g.birds.active.length, particulas: g.particles.count }; }; window.__session = () => { const p = g.player, B = g.birds; const dir = p.position.clone(); let kills = 0; const t0 = performance.now(); for (let leg = 0; leg < 60; leg++) { const a = leg * 0.7; p.position.x += Math.cos(a) * 150; p.position.z += Math.sin(a) * 150; p.position.y = g.terrain.heightAt(p.position.x, p.position.z); g.chunks.warmup(p.position); for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) { B.update(1 / 30); g.particles.update(1 / 30); } const alive = B.active.filter(b => b.alive); for (let k = 0; k < 3 && k < alive.length; k++) { const b = alive[k]; dir.subVectors(b.pos, g.engine.camera.position).normalize(); B.kill(b, dir); g.particles.feathers(b.pos, b.species.colors, 16, dir); kills++; } } for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) { B.update(1 / 30); g.particles.update(1 / 30); } return { abates: kills, segundosDeCPU: +((performance.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1) }; }; g.setPaused(true); return __mem(); })()
label: memória inicial (renderização pausada daqui em diante)

eval: (() => { const g = game, cm = g.chunks; const owner = [...cm.loaded.values()].find(c => c.grass); const ch = [...cm.loaded.values()].find(c => !c.grass); const t = (fn, n) => { fn(0); const s = performance.now(); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) fn(i); return +((performance.now() - s) / n).toFixed(2); }; const ocx = ch.cx, ocz = ch.cz; const r = { gramaMs: t(() => g.vegetation.fillGrass(owner.grass, owner), 20), terrenoMs: t(i => g.terrain.fillChunkGeometry(ch.ground.geometry, 900 + i, 900), 20), vegetacaoMs: t(i => { ch.place(950 + i, 950); g.vegetation.populate(ch); }, 20), tufos: owner.grass.count }; ch.place(ocx, ocz); g.terrain.fillChunkGeometry(ch.ground.geometry, ocx, ocz); g.vegetation.populate(ch); return r; })()
label: custo de geração por etapa (sem SwiftShader disputando a CPU)

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, inp = g.input, cam = g.engine.camera; const times = []; inp.down.add('KeyW'); inp.down.add('ShiftLeft'); for (let i = 0; i < 1200; i++) { const t0 = performance.now(); p.update(1 / 60); g.weapon.update(1 / 60); g.birds.update(1 / 60); g.particles.update(1 / 60); g.audio.updateListener(cam); g.ambience.update(1 / 60, p, cam.position); g.voices.update(1 / 60, g.birds.active, cam.position); g.footsteps.update(1 / 60, p); g.music.update(); g.chunks.update(p.position); g.atmosphere.update(p.position, cam); inp.endFrame(); times.push(performance.now() - t0); } inp.down.clear(); times.sort((a, b) => a - b); const avg = times.reduce((s, t) => s + t, 0) / times.length; return { mediaMs: +avg.toFixed(2), p95Ms: +times[Math.floor(times.length * 0.95)].toFixed(2), p99Ms: +times[Math.floor(times.length * 0.99)].toFixed(2), maxMs: +times[times.length - 1].toFixed(2), acima8ms: times.filter(t => t > 8).length, quadros: times.length }; })()

eval: (() => { const q = game.quality, r = game.engine.renderer, sun = game.atmosphere.sun; const res = {}; const feed = (fps, secs) => { for (let t = 0; t < secs; t += 1 / fps) q.update(1 / fps); }; q.apply(0); feed(60, 6); res.inicio = q.level; feed(25, 10); res.apos10sA25fps = q.level; feed(25, 10); res.apos20sA25fps = q.level; res.pixelRatio = r.getPixelRatio(); res.sombra = sun.shadow.mapSize.x; feed(60, 30); res.apos30sA60fps = q.level; feed(60, 40); res.apos70sA60fps = q.level; q.apply(0); res.final = { nivel: q.level, pixelRatio: r.getPixelRatio(), sombra: sun.shadow.mapSize.x }; return res; })()
label: qualidade adaptativa (FPS simulado)

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, b = g.biome; let best = null; for (let r = 40; r < 800 && !best; r += 20) for (let a = 0; a < 6.28; a += 0.3) { const x = p.position.x + Math.cos(a) * r, z = p.position.z + Math.sin(a) * r; if (b.forest(x, z) > 0.95) { best = [x, z]; break; } } p.position.set(best[0], g.terrain.heightAt(best[0], best[1]), best[1]); p.velocity.set(0, 0, 0); g.chunks.warmup(p.position); g.chunks.resolveCollision(p.position, 0.35); const s = g.atmosphere.sunDir; p.yaw = Math.atan2(-s.z, s.x); p.pitch = -0.05; g.setPaused(false); return 'mata fechada (renderização retomada)'; })()
